note: Cross-platform goldens for the EPIC-29 correlation engine. correlation-input-v1.json is the shared INPUT (behaviour x score pairs reduced to the engine's day view); correlation-expected-v1.json is the OUTPUT both platforms must reproduce exactly — the bootstrap is seeded from the contract, so delta and the interval bounds are deterministic doubles and both suites assert them to 1e-12. The set deliberately includes the NULL case (both gates cleared, interval spans zero, must render 'no clear association'), the exactly-at-gate case, and one-below-gate cases for each of the three shortfalls, because the suppression behaviour is the part of this feature that is worth the most and is the easiest to erode. Regenerating: see README.md — the expectations were derived from the published method by a third implementation on purpose.
